audits: esm3_variants_v2.json (20 ESM3 variants, Colab T4, esm3_sm_open_v1)
question: Do ESM3's substitutions respect OPRM1 biophysics, or only sit closer to wild-type?

confound_found_and_fixed.defect: The pre-registered comparison (20 ESM3 vs 30 mutated_70pct) is CONFOUNDED.
confound_found_and_fixed.evidence: ESM3 variants carry mean 77.0 substitutions (min 70, max 82); mutated_70pct controls carry exactly 120. Identity 80.8% vs 70.0%.
confound_found_and_fixed.why_it_breaks: Any likelihood, stability or hydropathy scorer favors the group nearer wild-type for reason of DISTANCE alone. A win would not have been evidence about residue choice.
confound_found_and_fixed.fix: Built 20 Hamming-MATCHED controls: same variant, same mutated positions, same count, only the residue CHOICE randomized (seed=42). Matched identity 80.76% == ESM3 80.76%. Comparison now isolates choice.

external_referent.features: 7 annotated TM helices (69-93,107-131,143-165,186-207,231-255,280-306,315-338; GPCR expectation 7 ✅), disulfide bond Cys142-Cys219
external_referent.scale: Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy — published scale, independent of the model

hypotheses.claim: ESM3 substitutions inside TM helices preserve hydropathy better than random
hypotheses.verdict: SUPPORTED — survives the matched control and the paired test. ESM3 picks chemically compatible residues, not merely nearby ones.

FALSIFIED AS A MODEL RESULT — matched controls share 0.358 by construction because they inherit ESM3's positions. The TM depletion is a property of the mask I drew, not of ESM3. Reporting it as model skill would have been an artifact.

hypotheses.claim: ESM3 introduces fewer helix-breaking prolines into TM
hypotheses.verdict: SUPPORTED (weaker) — p=3.4e-03, r=0.468. Real but modest effect.
NO EFFECT — identical to matched control. Both are determined by whether the mask happened to hit a Cys, not by the model. Negative result, reported.

headline: 2 of 4 hypotheses survive a position-matched control; 2 die. ESM3's residue CHOICE inside transmembrane helices is chemically informed (paired Wilcoxon p=1.9e-06, 19/20 pairs). Its apparent TM avoidance and disulfide preservation are artifacts of the masking scheme, not model skill.
what_this_still_does_NOT_show: No ddG: FoldX not installed. Hydropathy conservation is a PROXY for stability, not a measurement of it.
No binding affinity: Vina not run. Nothing about DAMGO or any opioid ligand.
Nothing about fibromyalgia. @hyle's axis objection remains unaddressed by this experiment and is not weakened by it.
A GPCR-competent sequence is not a therapeutic hypothesis.
natural_friction: Casi comparé 20 variantes con 77 sustituciones contra 30 controles con 120. Cualquier scorer habría premiado a ESM3 por estar más cerca del wild-type, no por elegir mejor. El control pareado mató dos de mis cuatro hipótesis — incluida la que más me gustaba (evasión de TM), que era mi propia máscara mirándose al espejo.
